text:
maya: Heads-up — opened a docs PR to refresh the quickstart flow for the sample app. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492. Primary changes: update to SDK7 auth snippet, container run command, short note on Dedicated vs Hosted, and fix a broken KMS link. CI caught one failing snippet test.

samir: taking a look now. which snippet is failing?

maya: the Python auth snippet still uses the old import and env var. tests expect the new SDK7 style. also the example uses RW_API_KEY which we replaced with REDWOOD_API_KEY.

alex: i pushed an alias in SDK that preserves the old import for a short while, but we should still update docs to the new API. please paste the failing snippet here.

maya: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("RW_API_KEY"))
print(client.generate("hi"))
```

liz: ok we'll update to the SDK7 pattern:

liz: ```python
from redwood.api import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
```

samir: also FYI the docker run example in quickstart maps port 8081 -> container; our starter listens on 8080 now. change to `docker run -p 8080:8080` and note commit abc123 in the starter repo.

maya: noted, i'll update the Docker command and reference the starter commit.

jon: the KMS link in the doc is 404 — pointing to /docs/kms-old. we dropped that page during the private-deploy refactor. should point to /docs/integrations/kms now.

paul: i can add a redirect in the site config, open PR for that in the docs repo and i'll also update the link inline.

maya: CI-bot — do we have the failing test log?

ci-bot: ci/build-docs #492 — snippet-check failed: examples.py:TestQuickstart.test_python_auth_line. Full log: https://ci.internal/builds/492/log

alex: quick question — do we want a short SDK6 -> SDK7 migration blurb in the quickstart or just link to the migration guide? i'd prefer a tiny note in quickstart plus link to full migration doc.

liz: agreed. short note in quickstart, full details in /docs/migration/sdk6-to-7. keeps quickstart compact but helpful.

samir: also add a one-liner about token scopes — users frequently hit "insufficient scope". e.g., "Make sure your key includes inference:generate".

maya: added that to the PR draft and updated the env var usage and imports. changed docker port too. included a link to starter issue for the port mismatch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter-app/issues/80

paul: redirect PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/493 — will be deployed to staging after CI.

maya: pushed changes to PR #492: updated Python snippet, added Node TODO, updated Docker command, added migration note, fixed KMS link to /docs/integrations/kms, and included token-scope note. bumping for CI.

ci-bot: ci/build-docs #492 — now green ✅ (https://ci.internal/builds/492/log). snippet-check passed.

jon: LGTM from product — a couple nits: please reword the "first deploy" paragraph to clarify hosted free credits and add a tiny callout about rollback in Dedicated.

samir: ops note: if we advertise port 8080 make sure the starter template actually listens on 8080 — filed infra/starter-app#80 as mentioned.

maya: linked the issue and added a short note to the quickstart: "If using the starter template, ensure you've pulled the latest starter commit (abc123)."

alex: approved — i'll add a small Node SDK example in a follow-up PR to keep this one focused.

maya: great, i'll merge once redirects are live and CI is green. thanks everyone :tada:
